verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents its own 1.5- to 8-bit integer quantization, which covers INT4-style quantized models. A community user also reports that its Q6_K quantization nearly matches FP16 perplexity. Nothing in the pack shows it can load the named external formats (FP8, GPTQ or AWQ checkpoints); the evidence only covers its own GGUF-style quants. Missing for 10: evidence of FP8 support, evidence of loading GPTQ or AWQ models, documentation of format conversion or compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: 1.5-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, 4-bit, 5-bit, 6-bit, and 8-bit integer quantization for faster inference and reduced memory use
llama.cpp's Q6_K quantization nearly matches FP16 perplexity while being much smaller
